title: 需求要说明用途
A requirement needs a purpose
practice: 围绕 building、交易和食物，先问“它在游戏里用来做什么”。
The class questions what building, trading and food actually do.
knowledge: 范围控制：没有清晰用途的功能不自动进入本轮。
Scope control: a feature without a clear purpose is not automatically included.
expression: “我希望玩家能……，因为……；这一轮先不做……”
“The player should be able to … because …; this revision excludes …”
level: 有课堂讨论证据；不等于独立掌握
Discussion evidenced; independent mastery not established

title: 把点子接成闭环
Connect ideas into a loop
practice: 把抓怪与训练、买卖、料理、再狩猎连接起来。
Connect capture to training, trade, meals and further hunting.
knowledge: 资源输入、转换和结果：每个按钮都应改变可解释的状态。
Resources have inputs, transformations and outcomes; every action should change an explainable state.
expression: “先做 A，得到 B，再用 B 做 C；最后回到更难的 A。”
“Do A to obtain B; use B for C, then return to a harder A.”

title: 安全的状态转换
Safe state transitions
practice: 实现中把战斗、商店、探索分开；测试禁止倒下伙伴继续出场。
The implementation separates battle, shop and exploration and tests invalid fallen-partner selection.
knowledge: 状态机、实体身份与操作校验，防止异步动作串进错误阶段。
State machines, entity identity and validation prevent actions from leaking into the wrong phase.
expression: “在什么状态允许？不满足条件时应该怎样拒绝？”
“In which state is this allowed? How should invalid input be rejected?”
level: 从实际代码提炼的课后工程复盘，不冒称课堂已教完
Code-grounded retrospective, not claimed as fully taught in class

title: 测试证据也会出错
Test evidence can fail too
practice: 正常路径完成后，低血量夹具被存档覆盖，导致边界测试失败；更正夹具后重跑。
A low-HP fixture was overwritten by saving after the normal flow; correcting its setup enabled the boundary rerun.
knowledge: 区分产品缺陷、测试夹具问题和最终实机验收；失败不能直接删掉。
Distinguish product faults, fixture problems and final device acceptance; preserve failed evidence.
expression: “我怎样测、预期什么、实际什么、这次证明了什么？”
“How did I test, what did I expect, what happened, and what does this prove?”
level: 工程记录可核验；学生掌握程度待观察
Verifiable engineering record; learner mastery remains unassessed

怎样证明卖掉的是你选中的那只怪物？
How can you prove the correct monster was sold?

讨论过建房，但没有形成足够明确的用途；最终明确排除，不让一个新词无限扩张范围。

formula: 总进度 = (MVP完成率 + 资产完成率 + 发布运营准备完成率) ÷ 3。三个阶段等权；每阶段内部只数已完成的验收项。不表示工时、花费或日历时间占比。
